outcome: Objective voice parameters (fundamental frequency (F0), jitter, shimmer, noise-to-harmonics ratio (NHR), number of voice breaks (VBn), percentage of voice breaks (VB%))
cohort: Women who underwent vaginal delivery (n=unknown) and women who underwent cesarean delivery (n=unknown)
finding: While both modes of delivery resulted in some changes to voice parameters, objective voice parameters showed more significant improvement in the cesarean delivery group.
mod_finding: Objective acoustic measures showed more significant improvement in the cesarean delivery group, while vaginal delivery was associated with potential vocal trauma.
